title: Jesus... I Was The One Who Hurt Her And Never Said Sorry
topic: hurt a friend years ago and never apologised

bible.text: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I was the one who hurt her. It's been three years, and I never said sorry. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Today she showed up in my suggestions. I almost messaged her, then I closed the app.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've carried this for three years. That tells Me you still care about her.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if she's moved on? What if she reads it and never replies?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She might not. Saying sorry isn't a way to make her answer. It's a way to stop hiding from what you did.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I'm scared it will open everything up again, and she'll remember how much I hurt her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It might. But it might also let both of you finally close it. You can only do your part, so do it honestly.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Write the message. Leave the reply to Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Is there someone you still owe a sorry? 🙏
